_doc: E6.5 owner deferrals (SS ruling N-102, owner decision). Read by `asset_census.py --registry-check` and echoed into registry_coverage_report.json `deferred_by_owner`. Each entry: {asset_id: a registry asset id (validated against the committed registry seed), criterion_gate: one of the nine core gates, decision: 'N-<n>', state: non-blank}. A deferred asset is reported SEPARATELY: it is not an uncovered criterion, it never fails the check, and it is not a covered cell. Unknown ids, unknown keys, duplicates or a malformed entry fail --registry-check.
